theme: An open day, the girls home — two travel decisions at their deadline.
greeting: The whole day is yours, Dan — nothing on the calendar until dinner out tonight. It's a good window to close the December and Christmas-travel calls that have now hit their booking clock.

needsAttention.title: December break — pick a destination
needsAttention.detail: The decide-by was yesterday and the book-by is Oct 15. Six people over three weeks (Dec 13–Jan 2) is the year's thinnest inventory. The call is domestic vs. refundable-only international, since the passports land in November.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: P1, overdue since Sept 14. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out and prices up — a refundable PWM hold now takes the whole risk off the table, dates adjustable later.

needsAttention.title: Drive the Pathfinder south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 Maine-to-St Pete window opens in four days. Set the two travel dates and book the one hotel night so it isn't a scramble next weekend.

needsAttention.title: Term life quotes for Mike
needsAttention.detail: P2, due Sept 25 — deliberately parked until after Croatia, now live. Four kids and no coverage is the real gap; still missing the target coverage amount and term length.

flagged.title: LinkedIn invitations stacking up
flagged.detail: A run of new connection requests this week — KPMG UK external affairs, Morningstar Sustainalytics ESG, an OECD anti-corruption analyst, CohnReznick. Worth a quick networking sweep.

inbox.noise: Otherwise all newsletters and promos — WSJ, Foreign Affairs, JetBlue, local St. Pete and Paris travel lists.
inbox.clear: Nothing in the inbox is waiting on a reply from you.

The afternoon stays clear; the first and only commitment is dinner.
